description: Na₃Cr(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CrO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.42 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.18 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.41 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.39 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one B atom.
